name: Christopher Seabrook, 50, of Philadelphia (silhouette only)
depiction: Christopher Seabrook, 50, of Philadelphia, who pleaded guilty (S.D. Texas, November 2024) to possession with intent to distribute cocaine after fleeing a Border Patrol checkpoint near Sarita, Texas (July 2024), and was sentenced to 120 months (March 2025). Named on a label only (pleaded guilty, widely named by the US Attorney's Office and the press). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette, at the wheel and in court: no face, no features. NOT A LIKENESS.
